# TinyPNG

TinyPNG uses smart lossy compression techniques to reduce the file size of your WebP, JPEG, and PNG files.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tinypng/.

## Actions

- **Compress and Convert Image**: Compress and convert an image.
- **Compress and preserve metadata**: Compress an image while preserving specified metadata fields.
- **Compress and Store Image in Azure**: Compress an image using tinify and upload it directly to azure blob storage.
- **Download Compressed Image**: Retrieve a compressed image by its image id.
- **Get TinyPNG Compression Count** (read-only): Retrieve the number of compressions made this month.
- **Shrink and get image ID**: Shrink an image and return its tinypng image id.
